name.zh: 存在劣化综合症 / 杀刻

periods.description: A cross-world rejection/existence degradation disease. Acute cases can resolve, but chronic cases from repeated crossings corrode the entire 'road' of existence and are nearly fatal without Lectea treatment.
periods.principles: Worlds reject unnatural existence; repeated crossings accumulate unhealed destiny/existence distortion.
limitations: regression does not reset existence damage
requires specialized Lectea medical goddess treatment
